posts.body_html:
Here's a new leucophylla individual created by crossing all of these genetically different pink leucophylla clones here: sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/3343/leucophylla-pink-various-clones-baldwin with each other.

The results were absolutely stunning! Here's one in particular that is absolutely NEON pink! I think the camera got pretty close to capturing the actual color you see in person, although it's slighly a little more bling in person. These aren't even the fall traps, looking forward to that!!!

posts.body_html: S. leucophylla "neon pink" is looking amazing again this year. Interestingly, the spring traps have minimal areolation compared to the summer and fall traps, but the color and vigor are so phenomenal that I don't mind at all! These bad boys are nearly black in the mouth, and the color stretches almost all the way down the tube. While clones like "Black Sheer" can certainly get darker, most photos I've seen of it don't exhibit nearly this much "stretch" of pigment down the pitcher.
